_comment: Deleted a fabricated STATIC granting WARD with ward_type 'UNPREVENTABLE'. Malign has NO Ward -- its text is 'Stealth' plus 'Damage that would be dealt by Malign can't be prevented'. Ward is a real prevention keyword the engine reads declaratively, so this gave the card a shield it does not have while ALSO failing to implement the unpreventable-damage clause it does have. NOT IMPLEMENTED: unpreventable damage needs the damage pipeline to skip prevention for a named source. Stealth is printed and works.
